selection: Convenience sample of documented completed outcomes. Multiple decision questions may share an episode; not independent examples. Historical records were inspected by Codex; no model-generated gold labels or independent human relabeling.
preDecisionReconstruction: States are sanitized reconstructions, often containing diagnosed observations. They are not original pre-debugging prompts; triage may be easier than live work.
interruptionEvidence: Actual interruption counts and historical decision latency/token costs are unavailable; no savings label is invented.
